code:
SELECT LEN('Hello   ') AS Length;
-- returns 5, NOT 8
caption: LEN() ignores TRAILING spaces — but leading spaces still count. Watch out with CHAR columns (Lesson 41).
Change case in the output only — the underlying data never changes.
